sources.title: Noise nuisance
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states construction noise that is audible at the site boundary should normally be limited to 08:00-18:00 weekdays and 08:00-13:00 Saturdays unless agreed otherwise, and statutory nuisance controls may apply; this is borough control context, not parcel exposure.

sources.title: Noise, smells, smoke, light and dust pollution
sources.verified_claim: Havering's environmental-health service addresses noise and other nuisance categories including smells, smoke, light and dust, while also setting limits on what the council can control; complaint scope is not parcel-development evidence.

sources.title: What you need to know
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states construction and building work is allowed 08:00-18:00 Monday-Friday and 08:00-13:00 Saturday, with no such work on Sundays or bank holidays; operational rules are not evidence of a sample parcel's construction status.

sources.title: Air quality
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's air-quality page links current borough action to road, building and construction emissions and points to its 2023-2025 Air Quality Action Plan; the plan period is retained as a source-age limitation.

sources.title: Lambeth's Air Quality Action Plan
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth identifies its Air Quality Action Plan 2023-25 as the plan describing borough actions to reduce air pollution; because the stated plan period ended in 2025, it is retained as policy-history/context rather than assumed current parcel compliance.

sources.title: Chapter 3 Design
sources.verified_claim: London Plan Policies D13-D14 require Agent of Change and noise mitigation, including site-specific assessment of existing and proposed nuisance sources; policy requirements do not establish the acoustic condition of a sample parcel.

sources.title: Pollution and air quality
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's current air-quality programme focuses on reducing exposure to harmful pollution and meeting tighter health-based targets; regional policy and monitoring context is not an exact parcel measurement.

sources.title: ADD2839 Air and Noise Pollution Mitigation Through Integrated, Society-Centred Actions (ATMOPOLIS)
sources.verified_claim: City Hall approved participation in the 2026 ATMOPOLIS research programme on combined air and noise exposure and health impacts; a research programme does not provide parcel-level exposure or planning outcomes.
